unverified_statements.text: Who keeps Layercake.ref_campaign_year_config up to date with future Campaign Years, and how far ahead it is filled in production.
unverified_statements.reason: The attributes load fails on any date no Campaign Year covers, so the client needs to know who adds new years and when. No artefact says; the question was raised and the answer was deferred. The pack only says the table must cover each Campaign Year before it starts, without naming who maintains it.

unverified_statements.text: Until Damian maps the 'APP' item codes as 'enrolment or application fee', no invoice can count as fee-only, so an enrolment-fee-only invoice could become a contact-year's segment invoice and set its payment method and payer type.
unverified_statements.reason: This is a consequence I reasoned out, not one any artefact records. The 12 seeded codes include no enrolment fee code, and a line with no mapping counts as unmapped, which never makes an invoice fee-only. The team should confirm it before it goes into Known limitations.
